subject: website
name: Restfox
summary: An HTTP and socket testing client, built from upstream's open source (MIT) at a pinned commit. Every script ships in its own files: Level 3. Its page-view ping to the developer's Umami analytics is sent by the app's own bundled code, not external code, so it keeps Level 3 but fails Level 4: with the star-count request to api.github.com it is an unverified connection made when the app opens. Not private: the ping and every request show your IP address.

operations.name: Send a request and read the response
operations.note: The code does what it promises. The server the user names answers, sees your IP address and decides what comes back.

operations.name: Keep workspaces, requests and history
operations.note: Stored in this site's browser storage on this computer, with no account.

operations.name: Run a plugin the user adds
operations.note: Plugins are code the user adds, run in a sandbox inside the page. They are not loaded unless the user installs one.

connections.name: Developer analytics (umami.artelin.dev)
connections.note: A page-view ping sent when the app opens, unless Settings > Advanced > Disable Page View Analytics Tracking is ticked. It carries the screen size, language and app version.

connections.name: GitHub star count (api.github.com)
connections.note: Asked when the app opens, with no setting. It only changes a displayed number.

connections.name: Servers the user types as request addresses
connections.note: Any public https address, and plain http only for localhost on ten ports. Answers are shown as received.
